p.title: v59.94 KR index weights read a blank day ratio as a 0% move
p.symptom: A stock whose Naver fluctuationsRatio was blank was published in kr-index-weights.json with ret1dPct 0 and its weight computed on the unadjusted cap.
p.root_cause: The local num() helper in fetch-kr-index-weights.mjs converted with Number(), and Number('') is 0, so a blank ratio passed the ret != null check.
p.fix: num() returns null for a blank, whitespace, null or undefined input before converting (comma stripping kept), so a stock with no reported ratio is excluded like other unusable rows; '0.00' still reads as 0.
p.violated_rule: A missing value stays missing (never 0 or a guess).
p.prevention: ci-event-briefs-check calls marketWeights with blank and null ratios (excluded, remaining stock weightPct 100) and a '0.00' ratio (kept with ret1dPct 0).
p.verification: node scripts/ci-event-briefs-check.mjs and node scripts/ci-pipeline-semantics-check.mjs pass; the new case fails against the previous producer.

changelog: **KR index weights: a blank day ratio is missing ({P}):** a stock with no reported change is no longer published as a 0% move on its unadjusted cap; it is left out of the weights like other unusable rows.
note: v59.94: KR weights blank ratio is missing
